text_blocks.snippet: Heart failure symptoms can vary, but common signs include shortness of breath, fatigue, swelling in the ankles and feet, and a persistent cough. Other symptoms can include a fast or irregular heartbeat, sudden weight gain, and nausea.
snippet_highlighted_words: shortness of breath, fatigue, swelling in the ankles and feet, and a persistent cough

list.snippet: Shortness of breath: This can occur during activity or even at rest, and may be worse when lying down.
Fatigue and weakness: Feeling unusually tired or weak, even after resting, is a common symptom.
Swelling (edema): Fluid buildup can cause swelling in the ankles, feet, legs, and abdomen.
Persistent cough: A cough, especially when lying down, can be a sign of fluid buildup in the lungs.
Rapid or irregular heartbeat (palpitations): The heart may beat faster or skip beats.
